No API Keys, No Subscriptions. No Ads. No Servers. Your own AI forever.

Mees AI is a modular intelligence workspace for total privacy and control. Run models 100% offline. With dual themed workspaces—Arena for multi-agent debate and Journal for private reflection—Mees AI replaces monthly SaaS fees with a permanent, personal AI companion.

AI Engine. Total Control.

- Local On-Device Mode: Gemma and EmbeddingGemma run directly on your phone. Air-gapped, zero latency, no internet needed.


Arena: Multi-Agent Debate & Squad Brainstorming

Deploy a team of specialized AI personas to stress-test your ideas from every angle:

- The Crucible: Force your AI squad to fiercely debate proposals and expose hidden flaws.
- Panel Interview: Face sequential questions from distinct experts to prep for high-stakes meetings.
- Brainstorm: Watch personas build on each other's ideas in real time.
- Scenario Squads: Describe any situation and AI auto-generates a custom cast of personas suited to the scenario.
- Cognitive Frameworks: Apply Six Thinking Hats, First Principles, and Blindspot Finder to your debates.

Journal: Your Private Reflection Engine

Your thoughts belong to you. Local mode guarantees entries never touch a cloud server.

- Ask Journal: Query your history in natural language. AI surfaces hidden patterns and personal growth.
- Semantic Memory Search: Find past thoughts by meaning, not keywords, using on-device embeddings.
- Reflection Chips: AI suggests prompts based on your entries. Pin them to guide your next conversation.
- Mood Tracking: Tag entries with sentiment. Track emotional patterns over time with visual charts.
- On This Day & Calendar Warp: Surface past entries from previous years and explore chronologically.
- Zen Editor: Distraction-free canvas for focused, deep writing.

Journal-to-Arena Handoff

Turn private thoughts into actionable strategies. Hand off any journal entry directly into Arena. Take a quiet reflection and discuss it with your AI personas for a full squad debate or structured problem-solving breakdown.

Studio-Grade Offline Voice & Dictation

- Live AI Auto-Punctuation: Speak freely while Vosk + Gemma format and punctuate your dictation into clean prose in real time.
- 100+ Offline Piper Voices: Natural offline TTS. Customize speed, pitch, and voice for every persona.
- Far-Field Acoustics: Enhanced voice capture for hands-free use at a distance.
